News alert on: Date: 26 Feb 18 Time: 20:38 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is New York State Common Retirement Fund’s Largest Position – The Lincolnian Online AAPL 
Moody Lynn & Lieberson LLC now owns 137,356 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $19,782,000 after purchasing an additional 44,898 shares in the last quarter. OLD Point Trust & Financial Services N A now owns 2,824 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $406,000 after purchasing an additional 50 shares in the last quarter. Drexel Hamilton reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $208.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 30th. Apple has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.64. In other news, insider Eduardo H. Cue sold 65,361 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Thursday, November 30th.
